clean: Dear Mr. Casalanos, I'm writing on behalf of the four pharmacies in the Westbrook group to raise a concern about delivery time. Over the past six weeks, our morning deliveries have arrived after 11 a.m. on more than half of all days, against a contract window of before 9. This has a real impact on patients, because prescriptions that are waiting on stock can't be collected until the afternoon, and several of our patients travel in from rural areas by bus. We've raised this with the depot on several occasions, most recently with Ludmilla on the 3rd of October, but haven't seen any improvement. We'd be grateful if you could look into the routing for our area and let us know what can be done. We've attached a log of delivery times from all four branches. If the situation doesn't improve by the end of the month, we'll need to review our arrangements. Yours sincerely, Barnaby Chundron, Operations Lead
